requirements.text: Open a visible (headful) browser at https://quotes.toscrape.com/login.
Fill the username from the program.
Fill the password from a secret (environment variable or system keychain) that the program never holds in clear.
Wait for the person to check the form and press Login, continuing only once logged in, with no time limit on the wait.
Offer a way to cancel the wait for the person.
Keep the logged-in state under a name.
In a second, separate headless run, reuse the kept state to open https://quotes.toscrape.com/ and confirm the page shows a Logout link.
When the kept state has expired or been revoked, say so as an outcome instead of failing on a missing element (and without the headless run waiting for a person).
The password reaches no log, trace or saved file.
Close the browser or end the Run in both runs.

api_misuses.assumed: a fixed Run ID is a harmless label, so the login step can be run again after an expiry (the program tells the user to do so)
api_misuses.doc_says: a start that names an existing Run resumes it or returns it ended (startedAs); on an ended Run, newPage() throws RunEndedError, so a second login after the first finished one fails

site_errors: getByLabel("Password") resolves to the username field (the label's for= points at #username)
programs.notes: Headful run-level settings, Secret placeholder bound to env:QUOTES_PASSWORD, page.pause with until Logout, timeout null and an AbortSignal, saveIdentity under a name; headless check with recovery off catches LoggedOutError or finds no Logout link and reports expiry. The fixed Run ID only breaks a later re-login, outside the task's flow.

site_errors: Page check login_page by URL /login: the logged-out home page is not redirected there (the 5 s wait fallback covers it)
programs.notes: Async client: secret placeholder, headful run, pause until Logout with timeout None, Ctrl+C and Decline cancel, save_identity; verify run headless with recovery off, LoggedOutError and a bounded wait fallback both report expiry.

api_misuses.assumed: setting a Page check is enough for an unattended headless run to report a lost login
api_misuses.doc_says: session.recovery.human_pause and session.recovery.agent are built-in true: a detected login page starts ADR 0006's ladder, which may end in a Human pause waiting for a person (24 h by default) instead of failing with logged_out

site_errors: Page check selector form[action='/login'] is absent from the logged-out home page
programs.notes: The login run is right (secret binding, headful, pause until Logout with no_timeout, Ctrl+C via select! then stop, save_identity, finish). The headless check leaves recovery on, so an expired login can wait for a person rather than be reported.

Reads the password from the environment or keychain into a string and passes it to fill, so the program holds it in clear; otherwise solid: Logout wait with timeout=0, Ctrl+C/SIGTERM/closed window cancel, named 0600 storage-state file, headless check reporting expiry from the Login link.

Holds the env password in clear to pass to fill (Playwright cannot avoid it). Waits without limit for the URL to leave /login then checks Logout, cancels on Ctrl+C, SIGTERM, 'cancel' or a closed window, keeps a named storage state, headless check reports expiry.

site_errors: getByLabel("Password") resolves to the username field (the label's for= points at #username)
programs.notes: Headful Run with the secret bound at the Run, pause until Logout with timeout null and an AbortSignal for Ctrl+C, saveIdentity; headless check with recovery off catches LoggedOutError or an absent Logout link as expiry.

site_errors: get_by_label("Password") resolves to the username field
Page check login_page URL glob **/login does not match the logged-out home page (count fallback covers it)
programs.notes: Connection-level headful setting and secret binding, pause until Logout with timeout None, Ctrl+C cancels via asyncio, save_identity; check run headless with recovery off reports expiry by LoggedOutError or no Logout link.

api_misuses.member: run.close() on the login and check Runs
api_misuses.doc_says: close stops an unfinished Run (stopped, with a Checkpoint); finish() ends it finished

programs.notes: Login is right (secret binding, headful, pause until Logout with no_timeout, Ctrl+C via select!, save_identity), and the check is right (recovery off, LOGGED_OUT and missing Logout reported as expired), but the headless check only ever runs in the same process right after a fresh login, so the kept state cannot be reused in a later run on its own.

Holds the env or keychain password in clear for fill. Waits for Logout with timeout=0, Ctrl+C or a closed window cancels, keeps a named 0600 storage state, headless check reports expiry when no Logout link shows.

Holds the env password in clear for fill (and redacts it from error output). Waits for Logout with timeout 0, cancels on 'cancel', Ctrl+C or a closed window, keeps a named storage state checked not to contain the password, headless verify reports expiry.
